comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Available during all five periods of the 16th Century. Chrono quest titles from those eras also make it visible, of course. The recipe NPC is a lumberjack near the church.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock/item (time period),
gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4493 (NPC location)
